summary: 一种常见且广泛使用的精神活性植物，在世界部分地区开始取得医疗甚至娱乐用途的合法地位。通常吸食或食用，主要作用为放松与对食物的偏好——俗称“嗨（stoned）”。
effectsSummary: Euphoria, relaxation, altered perception of time and space, increased appetite, dry mouth, red eyes, impaired short-term memory.
dosageRemark: Effects vary greatly between strains and individuals. Start with a small amount, especially with edibles.
generalRisks: Impaired short-term memory and concentration, anxiety and paranoia (especially at high doses), respiratory issues when smoked, dependency risk with heavy use.
longtermRisks: Long-term heavy use, especially when started in adolescence, can lead to cognitive impairment, reduced motivation, respiratory issues, and dependency.
saferUse: Start with a low dose, especially with edibles.
Avoid smoking in favor of vaping or edibles.
Do not drive under the influence.
